entities.name: Tajuru Nation
entities.description: Elven nation of Murasa on Zendikar, the largest and most prominent elf faction, open to other races and skilled innovators.

entities.name: Murasa
entities.description: Continent of Zendikar whose massive jaddi treetops housed the Tajuru.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: Plane on which Murasa and the Tajuru are found.

entities.name: Sutina
entities.description: Speaker of the Tajuru nation who led it to prominence.

entities.name: Tumbled Palace
entities.description: Capital of the Tajuru, on the cliffs of Sunder Bay.

entities.name: Kozilek
entities.description: Eldrazi in whose tentacles Sutina died.

entities.name: Nisede
entities.description: A later leader of the Tajuru.

events.summary: Under Speaker Sutina the Tajuru became the largest and most prominent elf faction on Zendikar.
